summary: Enhance your expertise in spatial data with our Advanced Analytics Training. Discover advanced techniques to analyze and interpret complex datasets effectively
lede: Spatial data science uses geographic data to find patterns and support location-based decisions. For GIS analysts and other professionals who already work with geographic data, the course covers preparing and querying spatial datasets, testing clusters with spatial statistics, and building multi-criteria site-selection models. Participants also practise automating geoprocessing workflows and presenting findings in maps and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with geographic data and need stronger analytical depth. It suits technical practitioners, analysts, and decision-support roles that depend on spatial databases, raster layers, and map-based reporting. This course is designed for: GIS Analyst responsible for spatial joins, overlays, and map outputs. Geospatial Data Scientist building analytical workflows and predictive spatial models. Remote Sensing Analyst integrating raster, imagery, and change-detection outputs. Spatial Database Administrator managing PostGIS structure, indexing, and query performance. Urban Planner using spatial evidence for land-use and facility decisions. Environmental Analyst screening habitat, water, or land-use risk patterns. Location Intelligence Specialist translating geographic patterns into business decisions. Transport Planning Analyst modeling access, coverage, and route-related spatial effects. Infrastructure Asset Analyst prioritizing assets using spatial condition data. Public Sector Data Analyst aligning geographic evidence with reporting needs.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software and accessing GIS tools used in the session. No prior coding project is required, but you should be ready to work with sample spatial datasets, map layers, and guided exercises that involve PostGIS, QGIS-style workflows, or ArcGIS Pro-style workflows depending on the delivery setup.
